body:
T68 (archived) found `assertPreservesSuppression` / `assertClosureDoesNotLeak` (`test/gateway/narrowing.ts`) advertised in `src/gateway/SUBSTRATE-HAZARDS.md` H1 as THE structural defense for the operand-set suppression hazard, with zero callers. T32 (#198, container lifting) closed the headline claim — five container files now route through the helpers (`container-scope.test.ts`, `container-detach-record.test.ts`, `container-wall.test.ts`, `container-curated.test.ts`, `adopt-law.test.ts`). This ticket is what's left: the sites T68 named that T32 did not touch.

STILL UN-ROUTED, each asserting suppression closure by hand-rolled assertions instead of the shared helpers:

- **The seeding edge / offered lens** — `test/gateway/negation-closure.test.ts` hand-rolls its own struck/live assertions and does not import `narrowing.js`. This is the T38 site (`withNegationClosure`, `src/gateway/ingest.ts:129-147`).
- **`freeze`** — `test/gateway/container-identity.test.ts` does not import `narrowing.js`; its closure rail (`:233`) asserts plain set membership, the shape `narrowing.ts:13-17` names as "the rail that passed while the bug shipped." (This is also T52 part 3 — routing it there is fine; do not double-build if T52 lands first.)
- **Federation `translate`** — `test/federation/normalize.test.ts:263` ("a source the operator struck is never re-rendered into the living dialect") asserts the struck-source behavior directly against `translate.ts`, not through the shared helpers. (T58 is actively fixing `translate.ts`'s suppression bug; this ticket is about the RAIL's voice, not the fix — coordinate so the T58 fix lands with a narrowing-routed rail rather than a bespoke one.)
- **`migrate`** — `test/migrate/survival.test.ts` (the §20 withdrawn-law rail, T41) writes its own struck/transitive-struck checks (`isStruck` helper at `:84`) rather than `isSuppressed`/`assertPreservesSuppression` from `narrowing.ts`.

GOAL: one voice for H1 rail discipline. Every site above should call `assertPreservesSuppression` and, where the operation can leak a struck claim across a narrowing boundary, `assertClosureDoesNotLeak` — instead of each file re-deriving what "still struck at the destination" means.

OUT OF SCOPE: the village (`demos/village/`) is parked per CLAUDE.md; do not route it as part of this ticket. Container-identity/`freeze` may instead close under T52 — do not build both; whichever lands first should route the other's site or hand off explicitly.

CARE: do not backfill these cases over already-merged code without reading each site fresh — a rail written by the author of merged code shares its premise (CLAUDE.md, the three-hollow-rails lesson). Derive each case from what H1 says must hold, then check the site against it, per T68's own CARE note.

RAILS: the edited test files themselves — `test/gateway/negation-closure.test.ts`, `test/gateway/container-identity.test.ts`, `test/federation/normalize.test.ts`, `test/migrate/survival.test.ts` — each gaining a narrowing-routed assertion alongside (or replacing) its hand-rolled one.
title: Route the remaining narrowing sites through the shared H1 helpers
